endpoints.summary: Create an agreement for recurring payments
endpoints.description: You can use this endpoint to create a new agreement.

endpoints.summary: Get information about a single agreement for recurring payments
endpoints.description: You can use this endpoint to get information about a single recurring payments agreement.
You can use this endpoint to search for recurring payments agreements. The agreements are sorted by date, with the most recently-created agreements appearing first.

endpoints.summary: Cancel an agreement for recurring payments
endpoints.description: You can use this endpoint to cancel a recurring payments agreement in the `active` status.
Search transactions for the authenticated account using the provided search parameters. Returns a paginated list of payment search results.

endpoints.summary: Send card details to authorise a MOTO payment
endpoints.description: You can use this endpoint to [authorise payments](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/moto_payments/moto_send_card_details_api/) you have created with `authorisation_mode` set to `moto_api`.
Runs all registered health checks and returns a JSON response indicating the health status of each check. Returns HTTP 200 if all checks are healthy, or HTTP 503 if any check is unhealthy.

endpoints.summary: Get information about a payment’s refunds
endpoints.description: You can use this endpoint to [get a list of refunds for a payment](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/refunding_payments/#get-all-refunds-for-a-single-payment).

endpoints.summary: Check the status of a refund
endpoints.description: You can use this endpoint to [get details about an individual refund](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/refunding_payments/#checking-the-status-of-a-refund).
You can use this endpoint to [fully or partially refund a payment](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/refunding_payments).

endpoints.summary: Get information about a single payment
endpoints.description: You can use this endpoint to [get details about a single payment you’ve previously created](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/reporting/#get-information-about-a-single-payment).

You can use this endpoint to [get a list of a payment’s events](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/reporting/#get-a-payment-s-events). A payment event is when a payment’s `state` changes, such as when the payment is created, or when the paying user submits their details.

You can use this endpoint to [search for payments you’ve previously created](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/reporting/#search-payments/). Payments are sorted by date, with the most recently-created payment appearing first.
You can use this endpoint to [create a new payment](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/making_payments/).
You can use this endpoint [to cancel an unfinished payment](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/making_payments/#cancel-a-payment-that-s-in-progress).
You can use this endpoint to [take (‘capture’) a delayed payment from the paying user’s bank account](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/delayed_capture/).

endpoints.summary: Handle GET request for denied requests
endpoints.description: Returns a 400 Bad Request error with REQUEST_DENIED_ERROR when a request is denied by Naxsi rules. Logs the violated rules from the x-naxsi_sig header.

endpoints.summary: Handle POST request for denied requests
endpoints.description: Returns a 400 Bad Request error with REQUEST_DENIED_ERROR when a request is denied by Naxsi rules. Logs the violated rules from the x-naxsi_sig header.

endpoints.summary: Handle PUT request for denied requests
endpoints.description: Returns a 400 Bad Request error with REQUEST_DENIED_ERROR when a request is denied by Naxsi rules. Logs the violated rules from the x-naxsi_sig header.

endpoints.summary: Handle DELETE request for denied requests
endpoints.description: Returns a 400 Bad Request error with REQUEST_DENIED_ERROR when a request is denied by Naxsi rules. Logs the violated rules from the x-naxsi_sig header.
You can use this endpoint to search disputes. A dispute is when [a paying user challenges a completed payment through their bank](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/disputes/).

You can use this endpoint to [search refunds you’ve previously created](https://docs.payments.service.gov.uk/refunding_payments/#searching-refunds). The refunds are sorted by date, with the most recently created refunds appearing first.

Accepts a CreateTelephonePaymentRequest and creates a telephone payment via the connector service. Returns a TelephonePaymentResponse with the appropriate HTTP status code.
